import logging

class Capture(logging.Handler):
    records: list[logging.LogRecord]
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.records = []
    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord | None) -> None:
        if record is not None:
            self.records.append(record)

def main() -> None:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="ROOT %(name)s:%(message)s")
    managed = logging.getLogger("twins")
    detached = logging.Logger("twins")
    capture = Capture()
    detached.addHandler(capture)
    values = {"word": "before"}
    detached.warning("retained %(word)s", values)
    values["word"] = "after"
    print(capture.records[0].getMessage())
    detached.warning("bad %", 9)
    print(capture.records[1].msg)
    detached.removeHandler(capture)
    detached.info("ignored %", 2)
    detached.warning("last resort %04d", 7)
    managed.warning("managed %04d", 11)

main()
